description.value:
Supposedly, this precision electromag bolt-thrower remains in Militech's catalog because an exec’s child is rather fond of it. Another reason might be that it can punch arrows (even chemically-tipped ones) through concrete walls, and that certain international assassins might make great use of such a feature.

Cost: 7,500eb (Luxury)

Class: Excellent Quality Crossbow • Skill: Archery • Range: Longbow

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Long Limbs, Magrail Kit (w/ C-Thru, Headtoll), Smart Scope [w/ Opti-Zoom & Stalker Optics], Reinforced String, Sling, TUp (Optimized Rebuild [-1 Slot]) Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When charged, this weapon’s Tech Rebuild can see simple target outlines through up to one layer of Thin or Thick Cover [Stalker Optics] and can fire through up to one layer of Thin or Thick Cover [C-Thru]. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6) [Headtoll].

Range: Longbow
Pre-installed: Long Limbs, Magrail Kit (w/ C-Thru, Headtoll), Smart Scope [w/ Opti-Zoom & Stalker Optics], Reinforced String, Sling, TUp (Optimized Rebuild [-1 Slot]) Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
